help.description:
Lint, plan and apply Open WebUI Tools and Functions from a git folder.
The folder is the source of truth: `plan` shows the difference, `apply` makes the server match.
help.epilog:
exit codes:
  0  no difference / no problem found
  1  difference or problem found (plan drift, lint error, server rejected an item)
  2  tool error (missing config or token, cannot connect, 401/403, bad usage)
help.help: show this help message and exit
help.lang: output language: en or ko (also OWUI_DEPLOY_LANG, LC_ALL, LANG)
help.url: Open WebUI base URL (overrides OWUI_URL and server.url)
help.fake: use the built-in practice mock server instead of a real Open WebUI
help.lint: check Tools and Functions statically (nothing is executed)
help.lint_path: folder with tools/ and functions/ (or one .py file); default: the folders of the config file
help.plan: show what apply would change on the server
help.diff: also print unified diffs of changed content
help.prune_plan: show server-only items as deletions instead of unmanaged
help.fail_on_unmanaged: exit 1 when the server has items that are not in the folder
help.apply: make the server match the folder (create, update, toggle, optionally delete)
help.yes: do not ask for confirmation (required when stdin is not a terminal)
help.prune_apply: also delete server-only items (never happens without this flag)
help.message: commit message stored in the server history (default: short git hash)
help.pull: download Tools and Functions into files (valves values are never written)
help.force: overwrite local files that differ from the server
err.internal: unexpected problem ({detail}). Set OWUI_DEPLOY_DEBUG=1 to see the traceback.
err.connect: cannot connect to {url}: {detail}. Is Open WebUI running and the URL correct?
err.auth: the server refused the token (HTTP {status}: {detail}). Use an admin login token (JWT) or an API key; API keys need ENABLE_API_KEYS=true on the server.
err.bad_url: invalid server URL: {url}. Use a full URL such as http://localhost:8080.
err.not_json: {url} did not answer {path} with JSON. Is this an Open WebUI server?
err.unexpected: {url} answered with an unexpected shape. Tested with Open WebUI 0.13.3; check the server version.
err.no_url: no server URL. Set server.url in the config file, export OWUI_URL, pass --url, or try --fake.
err.no_token: no token. Export OWUI_TOKEN with an admin login token (JWT) or an API key, or try --fake.
config.missing: config file not found: {path}. Create it (see the README) or pass --config PATH.
config.duplicate_key: {where} declares "{first}" and "{second}", which are the same id "{id}" (ids are lowercased). Keep only one of them.
field.name: name
lint.OWD002.tools: no `class Tools` found (the server would answer only "[ERROR: Error creating tool]")
lint.OWD002.functions: no Pipe/Filter/Action/Event class found (the server would answer only "[ERROR: Error creating function]")
lint.OWD003: several Function classes in one file; the server uses only {chosen} and ignores {ignored}
lint.OWD004: file name "{name}" is not a valid id (letters, digits and underscores only, not starting with a digit)
lint.OWD004.case: file name "{name}" has upper case letters; the server lowercases the id to "{lowered}"
lint.OWD005.first_line: first line is not exactly three double quotes; the server ignores the frontmatter
lint.OWD006: {name} does not inherit from pydantic BaseModel
lint.OWD007: the server rewrites "{old}" to "{new}" when saving
lint.OWD007.weird: the server rewrites the text "{old}" inside a longer word to "{new}"; this is probably not what you want
lint.OWD008.doc: tool method {name} has no docstring (the model reads it as the description)
lint.OWD008.hints: tool method {name} is missing type hints for: {missing}
lint.OWD009: valve {name} looks like a secret but has a non-empty default in the source
lint.no_files: no .py files found under {path} (expected tools/ and functions/ folders)
fake.banner: Server: fake server (practice mock, not a real Open WebUI). State file: {state}
plan.unmanaged_note: only on the server; left alone without --prune
plan.delete_note: only on the server; will be deleted because of --prune
skip.bad_id: file name "{name}" is not a valid id; see lint OWD004
skip.folder_missing: the configured folder does not exist: {folder}. Check [paths] in owui-deploy.toml
config.not_utf8: {path} is not valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 or run `owui-deploy lint` to see the problem.
skip.config_without_file: the config declares "{id}" but there is no such file
apply.need_yes: stdin is not a terminal and --yes was not given; nothing was changed. Re-run with --yes to apply.
apply.hint_generic: hint: run `owui-deploy lint` for {kind} {id}; the server log has the real reason.
pull.kept: kept local file (differs from the server, use --force to overwrite): {item}
pull.invalid_id: skipped (id is not a valid file name): {item}
pull.valves_dropped: {n} valves values were not written (secrets stay on the server).
pull.valves_note: Valves (settings and secrets) are not exported; they stay on the server.
